title: Rabbi Abba (HaKohen) bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 15:7 and Tanchuma, Behaalotekha 20. He relates of himself that when he saw a group of people he would take a different road, so as not to trouble them to stand up for him. When he came before Rabbi Yose bar Zevida (Rabbi Yonah’s colleague), he said to him: “You must pass before them and they will stand up for you, and you will bring them to fear of Heaven.” Hyman infers from this that he belonged to the fourth generation; but Rabbi Abba bar Pappa belonged to the third generation, with Rabbi Zeira.

notes.text: The supplied במ״ד is read as Bamidbar Rabbah and שלה as שלא, preserving the negative “not to trouble them.” The generational contrast remains Hyman’s inference.

The story is directly present in the consulted Buber Tanchuma, Beha’alotcha 20, naming Abba HaKohen bar Pappa and Yose bar Zevida. The consulted Bamidbar Rabbah 15:7 instead concerns the menorah. Hyman’s supplied locator remains unchanged; the digital numbering and editions are kept distinct.
